summary: Short residential kerb with houses 7-23 m away and a steep grade.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings on both sides within 16-23 m; house 16 m at the start and 7 m near the end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerb; no clear parked cars or lay-by to judge room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street joining a busier road at the end.
drivers.convention: No signs; no sign of vans staying here.

flags: House within 10 m of the far end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the start; open to the afternoon sun further along.

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace north kerb, start of stretch under the big tree
